name: Z.AI
billing: Check the standard API account’s balance and model pricing. The GLM Coding Plan uses a separate endpoint; do not assume that subscription covers the package’s default standard API endpoint.

steps.title: Sign in to the Open Platform
steps.body: Register or sign in to Z.AI using the platform link in the official quickstart.

steps.title: Create a standard API key
steps.body: Open API Keys management and create a Standard API Key for this application. Store it privately on your machine.

steps.title: Check balance and endpoint
steps.body: Review billing and choose a model available to your standard API account. Keep the model, key and endpoint compatible; Coding Plan configuration is a separate workflow.
